subject: ddl: pass runtime info through args for reorganize partition related (#56656)
summary: Review scope: this commit vs first parent, focusing on DDL partition reorg/remove/alter rollback + schema-diff/infoschema bundle metadata. The change routes reorg-partition runtime IDs through `jobCtx.jobArgs` (adds non-persisted `TablePartitionArgs.NewPartitionIDs`) and ensures rollback conversion sets `jobCtx.jobArgs` before helpers/schema-diff use, removing dependency on `job.CtxVars`. Call paths for `ActionReorganizePartition/RemovePartitioning/AlterTablePartitioning` (and rollback) set `jobCtx.jobArgs` before any type assertions; runtime IDs are populated in the same step before `updateSchemaVersion`, so metadata/bundle updates remain consistent. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, consistency, compatibility, concurrency, or metadata/state-machine handling for the touched areas.
